# GIMP
> GIMP is a free and open source image editor for photo retouching, digital art, graphic design, and image processing.

The GNU Image Manipulation Program provides downloads, documentation, tutorials, release information, and contributor resources for users, artists, developers, and community members across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Core Site
- [GIMP Home](https://www.gimp.org/): Main entry point for the GNU Image Manipulation Program and its core capabilities.
- [About GIMP](https://www.gimp.org/about/): Overview of GIMP, its purpose, history, licensing, and project background.
- [Downloads](https://www.gimp.org/downloads/): Download current GIMP releases for supported platforms and packaging formats.
- [News](https://www.gimp.org/news/): Official announcements, release posts, development updates, and project news.
- [Documentation](https://www.gimp.org/docs/): Central hub for manuals, help resources, and user documentation.
- [Tutorials](https://www.gimp.org/tutorials/): Curated tutorial links for learning image editing and creative workflows.

## Downloads & Releases
- [Download GIMP](https://www.gimp.org/downloads/): Current stable downloads with platform-specific installation options.
- [Release Notes Index](https://www.gimp.org/release-notes/): Archive of release notes for major and minor GIMP versions.
- [GIMP 3.2 Release Notes](https://www.gimp.org/release-notes/gimp-3.2.html): Detailed changes, features, fixes, and improvements in GIMP 3.2.
- [News](https://www.gimp.org/news/): Release announcements often include highlights, packaging notes, and upgrade guidance.
- [GIMP News Feed](https://www.gimp.org/feeds/atom.xml): Atom feed for tracking official GIMP news and release updates.

## Documentation & Help
- [Documentation Home](https://www.gimp.org/docs/): Starting point for manuals, help pages, and documentation resources.
- [User FAQ](https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html): Frequently asked questions about usage, features, licensing, and troubleshooting.
- [Books](https://www.gimp.org/books/): Published books and longer-form learning resources about GIMP.
- [Tutorials](https://www.gimp.org/tutorials/): Community tutorial collection for practical editing and design techniques.
- [About GIMP](https://www.gimp.org/about/): Background context useful for understanding project goals and capabilities.

## Community & Support
- [Discuss](https://www.gimp.org/discuss.html): Community discussion channels, forums, chat, and social participation options.
- [Bug Reports](https://www.gimp.org/bugs/): Information on reporting bugs and accessing issue tracking resources.
- [Contacting Us](https://www.gimp.org/webmasters.html): Contact information for website-related questions and administrative issues.
- [GIMP's Team](https://www.gimp.org/team.html): Team page listing contributors and project members.
- [News](https://www.gimp.org/news/): Official updates relevant to users, contributors, and community members.

## Contributing & Development

- [Discuss](https://www.gimp.org/discuss.html): Community channels useful for contributor coordination and support.
- [GIMP's Team](https://www.gimp.org/team.html): Project team information relevant to governance and contributor context.

## Learning Resources
- [Tutorials](https://www.gimp.org/tutorials/): Community-maintained tutorials covering tools, workflows, and creative techniques.
- [Documentation](https://www.gimp.org/docs/): Official documentation for learning features and interface behavior.
- [User FAQ](https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html): Answers to common beginner and advanced user questions.
- [Books](https://www.gimp.org/books/): Recommended books for structured learning and reference.
- [News](https://www.gimp.org/news/): Posts that often explain new features and workflow changes in releases.
